name: Proposals for decisions
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the EU joint undertakings for the financial year 2023
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how eleven EU research partnerships spent their 2023 budgets and closes their accounts. It also lists problems it wants fixed: large unspent cash reserves, weak recruitment rules, missing conflict-of-interest policies, and reliance on outside staff. Each partnership must report back by 30 September 2025 on what it has done. These are opinions and requests for follow-up, not new laws.

- Parliament approves the 2023 accounts of eleven research partnerships and asks each to fix named problems.
- It affects the partnerships' managers, staff and the companies and researchers they fund.
- Each partnership must send Parliament a written follow-up report by 30 September 2025.
